name: matchingPairs.translate_mem
summary: Both functions stay Schwartz–Bruhat with the right supports, and the matching identity at k follows from the one at g⁻¹k.

steps.claim: χ(det g)·Φ(·g) is again Schwartz–Bruhat, supported on surjective matrices (`schwartzBruhat.comp`: composition with the homeomorphism x ↦ x·g, which preserves having a right inverse), and so is Ψ(g⁻¹·) on injective matrices; the matching identity at k ∈ GL_n(F) is χ(det g) times the identity of h at g⁻¹k, using g·firstCols(e, k) = firstCols(e, g·k) (`mul_firstCols`), the multiplicativity of det and of χ, and the definition of localSection.
steps.lean:
(χ g.1.det • (p.1 <| · * g.1), (p.2 <| g⁻¹.1 * ·)) ∈ matchingPairs χ e := ⟨⟨(schwartzBruhat
  _).smul_mem _ (schwartzBruhat.comp h.1.1 (· * g.2) fun _ ↦ .imp' (· * g.1ᵀ) (by simp
  [← transpose_mul])), schwartzBruhat.comp h.1.2 (g.1 * ·) fun _ ↦ .imp' (· * g.2) (by simp)⟩, by
  simpa [↓funext_iff, mul_add, localSection, Pi.mul_def, ← mul_firstCols, ← mul_assoc, ← map_mul,
    ← det_mul] using! congr(χ g.det • $(h.2) ∘ (g⁻¹ * ·))⟩
